story.slack_command: /ask-data-agent Why is the Executive Revenue dashboard wrong today?
story.prompt: Why is the Executive Revenue dashboard wrong today?

seed_memories.content: Finance Analytics treats Executive Revenue as executive-facing and high priority; escalate with an owner and an impacted-asset list.
Last month, a delayed Snowflake load caused stale revenue dashboard numbers until the team checked freshness before changing SQL.
The Finance Analytics handoff preference is to verify freshness and lineage first, then include the likely upstream cause.
Owner handoffs should name the downstream dashboard, the certified dataset, and any raw ingestion source that may be late.

external_context.snippet: Certified revenue dataset owned by Finance Analytics. Freshness check failed today after an upstream Snowflake load delay.

answers.mem9_only: I remember this is executive-facing and should be handled as high priority. The safest first step is to check freshness before rewriting SQL, then prepare a handoff with impacted assets and an owner.
answers.enriched: Treat Executive Revenue as high priority, then check DataHub first: mart.revenue is the certified Finance Analytics dataset behind the dashboard and its freshness check failed today. The likely path is raw.orders plus stripe.payments feeding mart.revenue, then downstream to Executive Revenue. Handoff Finance Analytics with those impacted assets and the upstream load-delay hypothesis before changing SQL.
